annotations.title: Get a signed receipt with its log proof

description: Use when you or your operator need proof of something alalanet stated: a live check, a preflight decision, a status change, a purchase report. Pass the event id (64 hex) from a previous result. Read-only and free. Returns the signed Nostr event (event_json, exact signed bytes), the signer key, and its RFC 6962 inclusion proof under a signed C2SP checkpoint, plus how_to_verify. Verify offline without trusting alalanet: check the signature, the proof up to root_hash, and the checkpoint signature with log_key.

event_id.description: the attestation event id (64 hex chars) from a check, preflight, purchase report or dispute pack (attestation.event.id)

name: get_attestation
